child_outcome_contract.exit_0: The child must emit a valid self-hashed artifact whose typed status and measurements satisfy its own contract.
child_outcome_contract.exit_1: The child may emit a valid self-hashed FAILED_MECHANISM or bounded nonpassing artifact. The supervisor validates and retains it, continues independent suites, and never relabels it as infrastructure solely because the exit code is nonzero.

execution.decisive_mode_requires: --execute plus an exact 40-hex frozen source commit
execution.environment: credential variables removed; PYTHONPATH bound to the frozen source tree
execution.invocation_ledger: append-only canonical JSONL with STARTED and COMPLETED records
execution.resume: A completed suite is skipped only after the supervisor revalidates its parent receipt, child bytes, source binding, schema, self-hash, return code, and frozen floors. A STARTED record without a valid COMPLETED record is terminal FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE and is never silently rerun in the same attempt.
execution.source_identity: Every decisive child and parent receipt is bound to the same exact clean frozen commit. The commit must contain source floor 2e78c258cfbee8be62462f61ed08ad04c00a8934 as an ancestor.

planned_outputs.child_artifacts: one immutable child artifact plus stdout/stderr for each suite

status_rule.FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE: Any required suite is absent, interrupted, timed out, malformed, unsealed, source-mismatched, hash-mismatched, or otherwise not validly measurable. This has precedence over FAILED_MECHANISM.
status_rule.FAILED_MECHANISM: All required suites produced valid measurable evidence, but at least one frozen mechanism or resource floor failed.
status_rule.PASS: Every required suite produced valid exact-source evidence and every frozen mechanism, replay, resource, and integrity floor passed.
status_rule.PARTIAL: Not a terminal Stage 10 supervisor status; partial child evidence remains preserved under the applicable FAILED_MECHANISM or FAILED_INFRASTRUCTURE result.
